# WritePixelFast

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WritePixelFast:Void x:Int32, y:Int32, argb:Int32, buffer:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |
| `argb` | In | Int32 | required | The color. Only the lower 24 bits are used; the pixel is always opaque. |
| `buffer` | In | Int32 | `0` | The locked buffer to write to. Defaults to the current buffer. |

## Description

Sets a pixel of a locked buffer. The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) first and the result shows after [UnlockBuffer](UnlockBuffer).

## Differences

* A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d`, and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message. A position outside of the buffer is ignored instead of writing into other memory.
* A buffer that [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made with the depth 30 takes A2R10G10B10, and one with 64 takes ARGB with 8 bits for each. [WritePixelFast64](WritePixelFast64) takes all 64 bits. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local n = 0
While n < 20
	LockBuffer BackBuffer()
	For y = 0 To 239
		For x = 0 To 319
			Local v = (((x + n * 4) / 40) Mod 2) Xor ((y / 40) Mod 2)
			If v Then WritePixelFast x, y, $FF8000 Else WritePixelFast x, y, $2040A0
		Next
	Next
	UnlockBuffer BackBuffer()
	Flip
	n = n + 1
Wend
```
